title: ChatWindowControlMap - control-id to subwindow map, 16 captions (ids/texts/22x22 SetRects/actions), caption ctor 0x417550 + tooltip 0x417640, belt slot layout + accessors 0x42D790/0x42D7C0/0x42D8A0, full keyboard dispatch 0x42CBD0 (gates, letter hotkeys, corrected VK byte table 0x42D550 incl. VK 0xBF '/', jump table 0x42D520, case semantics 1..11, belt tail 0x42D293), potion-use dispatch 0x42E2D0 with 0x45DD00 substring search, and kbd caller 0x41DD8A
objective: Produce the complete control/caption/belt/keyboard map of the chat-window root so the UI-reconstruction model can (a) name every caption and its action, (b) route every key, and (c) model belt slots and potion use exactly.
method: Linear capstone dumps of each body, byte-exact dump of the 179-byte VK table 0x42D550 (index = VK - 0x0D), dword dump of jump table 0x42D520 (12 entries), E8 rel32 byte-scan caller enumeration, GBK ('gbk','replace') decoding of string literals, and cross-reference with F312 (mouse dispatch) and Round-10 findings.
source: Mir3.exe image base 0x400000, .text raw bytes, capstone 5.0.9 via Tools/reverse-engineering/disasm_capstone.py (PeImage)

captions.storage: chat+0x567C + id*0xB4; fields: RECT +4, help-frame id +0x20 (init -1), byte +0x24 (init 1), byte +0x25 (init 0), x +0x28, y +0x2C, text +0x34, window_obj +0x14, id_lo +0x18, id_hi +0x1C, +0x30 (init 0)

setrect_22x22.pattern: caption ctor SetRect([0x4762B0] scratch, cap_x, cap_y, cap_x + frameW, cap_y + frameH) with frame = [window_obj + 0x38]; frame 22x22 for the 8 right-column captions

caption_ctor_0x417550.signature: ret 0x24, 9 args (ecx = caption, args on stack)
mapping: SetRect([0x4762B0], cap+4, x, y, x+frameW, y+frameH) frame = [window_obj+0x38]

belt_slots.hit_rects: 6 rects @ chat+0xD44 stride 0x10, 38x38, init loop 0x427DDE: slot i at (0x117+i*0x28, 0x1B0+i*0x10)
belt_slots.slot_layout: chat+0xDA4 + slot*0xC24; { dword valid +0, 0x308-dword item stack +4 (0xC20 bytes), byte gate +0x26 (skip time-gate), word potion type +0x2C }
belt_slots.clear_0x42D790: slot arg; rep stosd ecx=0x309 (0xC24 bytes) over [chat + slot*0xC24 + 0xDA4]; ret 4
belt_slots.take_0x42D8A0: args (slot, dst); valid -> rep movsd ecx=0x308 (0xC20 bytes) from [chat + slot*0xC24 + 0xDA8] to dst; call 0x42D790(slot); ret 1 (ret 8)
belt_slots.refill_0x42D7C0: SEH 0x474FD8; args at [esp+0xC38]/[esp+0xC3C]; arg2 != 0 -> slot target; iterates 6 slots [chat+0xDA4+i*0xC24] counting filled; 0x403AC0 call; head only - full semantics not closed

kbd_dispatch_0x42CBD0.signature: ret 8, 2 args: arg1 [esp+0x11C] = VK -> esi, arg2 [esp+0x120]
gates: [chat+0x5081C] != 0 -> push 8; call 0x42B980; if open -> 0x414DC0(chat+0x507EC chat-log, vk, arg2) hit -> ret 1

letter_hotkeys.note: GetKeyState edi = [0x476278]; control check via AH (test ah, 0x80) - unlike map-zoom's AL bit 7; document literally

map.Q 0x51: 0x42CC7C: toggle(0) + byte[chat+0x65A8]=0 + lea ecx,[chat+0x6718] + push -1; push 0x10C; push 0x10B; call 0x417880 (UI post)
map.Z 0x5A: 0x42CD35: belt clamp: word [chat+0xD40] clamped to 0..0x2E (>= 0x2E -> 0x2E; <= 0 -> 0); byte [chat+0xD42] = 2 when at max, 1 when at 0
map.C 0x43: 0x42CD93: trade 0x41EC10(0x47EF18, [0x777764], [0x777768], [0x777759], 1) (push order deepest-first) + net 0x451A70(0x8AB828, ret+8) when ret != 0
map.V 0x56: 0x42CDDA: minimap toggle, gate timeGetTime - [chat+0x6210] <= 0x64 (100ms); open -> 0x451770(0x8AB828); close -> [chat+0x6518]=0

vk_table.dispatch: 0x42CF1F: lea eax,[esi-0xD]; cmp eax,0xB2; ja 0x42D4B4 (case11); movzx ecx, byte [eax+0x42D550]; jmp [ecx*4+0x42D520]
vk_table.correction_note: CORRECTED vs Round-10 session notes: VK 0xBF '/' maps to 0x0A -> case10, not 0x0B; case0 (0x42D511) is the shared ret-0 tail produced by NO table byte (Round-10's 'every other byte 0x00..0x7B = 0x0B' was incomplete).

case_semantics.case1_enter_0x42CF3C: gate [chat+0xD38] != 0 && GetActiveWindow() == [0x8AB7B0]; walk msg list: [chat+0xD2C] = [chat+0xD30] top, [chat+0xD34] = count-1; node == 0 -> ret 1; node id == 9 && [0x513C4] == 0 -> advance current node+8 (index clamp 1..count); node id == 9 -> mov ecx, 0x47EF18; call 0x41C1E0 (close chat-log 9 + skill album 2 + trade) -> ret 1; node id != 9 -> push id; call 0x42ADB0 toggle(id) -> ret 1. Enter = close-current-window toggler.
case_semantics.case2_0x42CFF4_zoom_out: gate [0x7E04F0]==0 && GetActiveWindow()==[0x8AA48C] map hwnd; GetKeyState(0x11 Ctrl) with test al,0x80 (low byte bit 7, asymmetric with letter-hotkey AH checks - literal) -> dec [chat+0x6534] clamp >= 0 + 0x428790 redraw; else GetKeyState(0x12 Alt) -> dec [chat+0x6550] clamp + 0x428E00; gate fail -> wheel 0x42C7E0 fallthrough
case_semantics.case3_0x42D091_zoom_in: same gates; Ctrl -> inc [chat+0x6534] clamp < [chat+0x6530] + 0x428790; Alt -> inc [chat+0x6550] clamp < [chat+0x654C] + 0x428E00
case_semantics.case4_right_0x42D1B9: Shift (GetKeyState 0x10, AH) held -> byte [esp+0x10] = 0x21 '!'; 0x450C70(ecx = 0x8AA488); SetFocus([0x8AA48C]); ShowWindow([0x8AA48C], 5); SetWindowTextA([0x8AA48C], [esp+0x10]); SendMessageA([0x8AA48C], 0xB1, 1, 1); then fall into belt tail 0x42D293 with ebx=0; no Shift -> ebx=0 direct

belt_tail_0x42D293.slot_base: ebx -> edx = ebx*777 (shl 7 + lea x2 + lea x2), eax*4 = ebx*0xC24; slot = chat + ebx*0xC24; type word si = [slot + 0xDD0] (slot_base + 0x2C), byte [slot + 0xDCA] (slot_base + 0x26)
belt_tail_0x42D293.time_gate: [slot+0x26] != 0 -> skip; timeGetTime - [chat+0x29CD8]: > 0x7D0 (2000ms) -> proceed; <= 0x3E8 (1000ms) -> 0x42D472 reject; between -> type in {0x14, 0x15, 0x46} -> proceed else reject
belt_tail_0x42D293.valid_slot_use_swap: [slot] valid: [chat+0x20]==0 && [chat+0x24]==0 && [chat+0x28]==0 -> inline strcmp [chat+0x3C] vs 0x47ADB4 sentinel '陛傈' (loop 0x42D336/0x42D39E); text != sentinel && mode byte [chat+0x5A] in {0,3} -> 0x42D8F0 SWAP else 0x42D3E5; [chat+0x20]!=0 -> USE 0x42D9E0
belt_tail_0x42D293.empty_slot_place: [slot] invalid: [chat+0x20]!=0 && [chat+0x24]==0 && [chat+0x28]==0 && text != sentinel && mode in {0,3} -> 0x42DAA0 PLACE
belt_tail_0x42D293.chat_send_0x42D3E5: text != sentinel && [chat+0x20]!=0 && [chat+0x24]==0 && [chat+0x28]==0 -> mov eax,[chat+0x75] (chat channel); push text; push eax; push 0x3EE; mov ecx,0x8AB828; [chat+0x24]=1; [chat+0x34]=1; call 0x451910 (net chat msg 0x3EE); timeGetTime -> [chat+0x29CD8]; ret 1
belt_tail_0x42D293.reject_0x42D472: [slot] valid -> 0x47BDA4 '正在补充药水,请稍候.'; else slot+1 -> 0x47BD7C '腰带上的%d号快捷药水栏已经没有药水了.'; both via 0x46811C copy + 0x415280(chat, text)

case_semantics.case10_slash_0x42D14C: SetFocus + ShowWindow([0x8AA48C] map, 5); byte [chat+0x531EC]==0 -> copy 0x47AD94 '/'; SetWindowTextA(map, [chat+0x531EC]); strlen - 1 -> jmp 0x42D251 shared tail = SendMessageA([0x8AA48C], 0xB1, len, len)
case_semantics.case11_default_0x42D4B4: 0x42AAB0(chat, mouse [0x7DA1C4]/[0x7DA1C0]) -> -1 or != 0xe -> ret 0; == 0xe (skill book chat+0x524F0) -> 0x43A810(chat+0x524F0, arg1, arg2, y, x) hit -> ret 1

enter_close_path_0x41C1E0.body: game = esi; [game+0x2F660C] gate -> push 9; lea ecx,[game+0x2A548C]; call 0x42AC50 (remove window id 9 = chat-log); then [game+0x2F65DC] vtable[0x10](0) + [game+0x428050]=0 + [game+0x42804C]=0; [game+0x2D8644] gate -> push 2; call 0x42AC50 (remove id 2 = skill album) + [game+0x2D8614] vtable[0x10](0); [game+0x2ABA10] gate && byte [game+0x2ABA34]!=0 -> remove id 0 (trade) via 0x42AC50 + vtable[0x10](0) on [game+0x2AB9E0] + push -1/0x10C/0x10B post 0x417880(lea [trade+0x1C4]) + byte [trade+0x54]=0 + [game+0x2CF14C]=0 + 0x42FF90 (the push edi before 0x42AC50 is the callee-save bracket, not an arg; 0x42AC50 is ret 4 / 1 arg)

map_text_rebuild_0x450C70.note: string duplicate: strlen 0x46805C([esi+4]) -> alloc 0x468056(len, 1, 0x10) -> copy 0x468050([esi+4] -> dst); ecx = 0x8AA488 map text buffer; sibling 0x450CA0 = same with flag 0 (vs 1); called before SetWindowTextA in cases 4/5; 0x450CD0 (next fn) = chat-edit window proc (0x7ED submit etc.)

potion_use_0x42E2D0.dispatch: type byte [buf+0x22] -> > 0x1F -> 0x42E3EC msg 0x76; else index = byte [type + 0x42E428] -> jmp [eax*4 + 0x42E404]

substring_search_0x45DD00.signature: this = 0x8AB7A8; arg1 = potion name (buf+4), arg2 = token

conclusions: VK byte table 0x42D550 fully verified as raw bytes (179 B): Enter/Home/arrows/PgDn/VK 0x18/VK 0x1A/'/' have dedicated cases, everything else is case11; case0 = shared ret-0 tail produced by no byte.
Enter (case1) is a close-current-window toggler, not chat selection: top msg-list node id 9 -> 0x41C1E0 closes chat-log(9) + album(2) + trade; other ids -> toggle(id).
Arrow keys with Shift build map command strings '!'/'@' and SendMessageA the map hwnd; '/' key sets map text to '/' - all through shared tail 0x42D251.
Belt slot layout closed: valid +0, 0x308-dword stack +4, byte gate +0x26, type word +0x2C; time gate 2000/1000ms with type exceptions {0x14,0x15,0x46}; chat-send path uses net msg 0x3EE via 0x451910.
0x45DD00 is a substring search (strchr + repe cmpsb), not plain strcmp; potion tokens 0x47BDD4/0x47BDDC are 2-byte GBK reads that are not meaningful - flagged open.
Letter hotkeys are asymmetric with captions: Q(包袱栏 label) toggles id 0 (trade), D(信息窗口 label) toggles 0xb, N(设置栏 label) toggles 0xc - label/handler discrepancy flagged open.
closed_notes: VK table exact bytes in /tmp/cap_kbd.txt; jump table dwords exact. Old Round-10 session claim 'every other byte 0x00..0x7B = 0x0B' retracted by full 179-byte dump (VK 0xBF -> 0x0A). GetKeyState control checks are asymmetric: letter hotkeys use AH, map zoom uses test al,0x80 - both literal.
pending: Label-vs-handler discrepancies: cap14 包袱栏(Ctrl+Q, Q) vs Q->toggle(0) trade; cap10 信息窗口(Ctrl+D, D) vs D->toggle(0xb); cap11 设置栏(Ctrl+N, N) vs N->toggle(0xc).
Potion tokens 0x47BDD4/0x47BDDC GB2312 reads not meaningful; 0x45DD00 match -> msg 0x72/0x75 semantics inferred from name substring only.
0x42D7C0 (belt refill) full semantics not closed: 0x403AC0 call target unknown.
